final_blocks.final_block: The widow’s crisis belongs to a social world shaped by kinship obligations and household economy. Her husband’s death has therefore created more than private grief: debt now threatens the future of her entire household. The borrowed vessels and the work shared with her sons also show that Elisha’s response unfolds through the resources and relationships immediately surrounding her home.
